rationale: Post-hoc temporal overlap inventory of previously consumed complete8arm data. All raw event/result hashes and integer total gaps retained. Union/intersection prevents double counting; categories intentionally nonexclusive, no causal removal estimate. Eight largest gaps per run are display-only examples, not selection of analyzed data or acceptance threshold. No fits, physicalSQL, changed freshness/correctness gate or launch of new workloads. Follow-up adds real completion-record→ledger-completion, firstREST→checkpoint and checkpoint→next-observation capture bounds to reduce previously untagged time. Source-reviewed archive runs on foreground loop; bounds are still temporal, not function-entry/return or causal fsync timers. Prior successful audit outputs remain unchanged.
